name: CogniDiff
description: Privacy-preserving cognitive change detection. Captures typing rhythm only, never what you type.
//optional_host_permissions: CogniDiff ships with NO site access. Every monitored site is requested at
runtime with chrome.permissions.request(), so Chrome itself shows the
consent prompt and the user can revoke it from chrome://extensions at any
time. Static content_scripts were removed for the same reason: a fixed
matches list is consent the user never actually gave.
